jobs.description:
Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this treatment, they make a real difference every day in the lives of patients with cancer and other serious diseases.

The company is growing fast and is looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a strong eye for detail and a structured way of working that ensures high-quality results? Then we are looking for you!

At Legend Biotech, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference.
Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.

No experience yet? No worries, we’ll teach you everything you need to know. Just like we take great care of our patients, we also take care of our employees.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• You assist with daily quality analyses and help ensure reliable test results.	
• You check, clean, and disinfect equipment, and manage lab materials and waste.	
• You ensure safe and accurate sample transfers between departments.	
• You assist with various analyses in the labs.	
• You accurately log all your tasks in logs, forms, or the quality system.

	
• You have a Bachelor's degree in a scientific field, and/or experience in a Quality- related role.	
• You work detail- oriented with precision.	
• You have a strong quality- mindset.	
• You have a clean and accurate working style.	
• You like to collaborate with others.	
• You speak English well.	
• You are comfortable working with a laptop and MS-Office.	
• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.	
• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.

•

• 
You can remain calm in stressful situations

 
• 
You can maintain a good overview of your work

 
• 
You can communicate perfectly in English.

Do you enjoy keeping machines running smoothly? 
Then this technical challenge might be the perfect fit for you!

For an international chocolate producer, we’re looking for a maintenance technician to support the production department. You’ll be part of a skilled team ensuring the reliability and efficiency of the machinery through preventive maintenance and troubleshooting. You work closely with fellow technicians, line operators, and supervisors, reporting directly to the technical supervisor.

Your mission: keep everything running like a well-oiled machine — literally.
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on machinery and tools.
 - Perform preventive maintenance on equipment and installations.
 - Assist in machine setups and technical interventions.
 - Contribute to technical improvement projects.
 - Maintain order, cleanliness, and safety according to standards.
 - Follow lockout/tagout procedures during maintenance.
 - Manage production-related side streams (waste, recycling, ...).
 - Participate in internal quality and safety training sessions.
 - Carry out and register required quality inspections.

Are you the hands-on technician we’re looking for? 
Apply today – we’d love to meet you!
- Vaardigheden:
You have a technical secondary diploma (A2).
You have at least 3 years of experience in a production environment.
You have solid knowledge of electromechanics.
You work well independently and as part of a team.
You are accurate, quality-driven, and safety-conscious.
You can set priorities and take initiative.
You work hygienically and pay attention to order and cleanliness.
You’re eager to learn and professional in your communication.
You’re willing to work in a nightshift schedule.
Knowledge of pneumatics and cooling systems is a plus.

- Attesten:
No specific certificates required.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
A2 diploma required (preferably electromechanics).

- Vakkennis:
Experience with industrial machinery, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.

- Talenkennis:
Good command of English is required.

CE Driver Wanted in the Port of Antwerp

For a logistics company located in the Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced and motivated CE Driver.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transport of bulk goods and containers to and from various locations in and around the port. You will join a professional transport environment where safety, punctuality and clear communication are key.

What will you do?

• You are responsible for container transport to and from the Port of Antwerp.
• You collect containers from terminals and deliver them to customers.
• You carry out national transport, mainly within Belgium and the surrounding region.
• You check the load and ensure that containers are properly and safely secured.
• You ensure the correct handling of transport documents.
• You stay in contact with the planning department and communicate any problems or delays.
• You comply with the applicable safety regulations in the port.
• You are responsible for the proper inspection and care of your truck and trailer.

You will mainly work from the Port of Antwerp and carry out predominantly national and regional routes.

Interested?

Apply today and discover whether this position as a CE Driver in the Port of Antwerp is the right opportunity for you!

REF: MEC1

• You have a valid CE driving licence and Code 95
• Previous experience with container transport is preferred.
• Experience driving in the Port of Antwerp is a strong advantage.
• An  ADR certificate is a strong advantage.
• You are a safe and responsible driver.
• You are punctual, reliable and customer-oriented.
• You can work independently, while communicating smoothly with the planning department.
• You are flexible and have no problem with the dynamic nature of port and transport work.
• You have a sufficient level of  English to communicate smoothly.

• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have:
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly:
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Lead Project Engineer
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This position is a senior technical project engineering role rather than an administrative coordination or traditional project management function. You act as the technical lead within multidisciplinary CAPEX projects and help ensure that safe, feasible and maintainable solutions are delivered in a controlled project setting.

You work in an operational brownfield environment where safety, reliability, technical quality and minimal disruption to production are essential. The role combines deep Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad multidisciplinary view across engineering, execution and handover.

Responsibilities

• Define and safeguard the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Lead and integrate engineering activities across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core domain and close interaction with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure.
• Organise design reviews and evaluate solutions for safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Translate process and project requirements into robust Mechanical & Piping concepts and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Assess technical options for feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, and challenge them on content, quality, planning and completeness of deliverables.
• Facilitate technical decision-making, document assumptions and deviations, and ensure traceable decisions and follow-up actions.
• Identify technical and project risks and evaluate the impact of changes on scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Support the preparation of technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and contractual technical clarifications.
• Follow up Mechanical & Piping activities where relevant, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through to mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Advise the Project Manager through clear technical recommendations and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
• Coach engineers and contribute to standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing within project engineering.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The process consists of two interview rounds: a first interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview including a business case.

• You hold a master's degree in a technical discipline, or you have built an equivalent level through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You have extensive experience in technical design and engineering within an industrial or process environment.
• You bring demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering in the process industry or another heavy industrial setting.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You are able to provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, and to assess their deliverables critically.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, such as PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain it before the start.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an asset.
• You can work with project controls, including scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You explain complex technical topics clearly and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented way, with a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are a plus.

Does this sound like you? Apply right away!

Are you driven by people, motivated by success and energized by building relationships? Do you enjoy spotting opportunities, making things happen and working in a team where ambition and collaboration go hand in hand? Then this could be your next career move.

As a Recruitment Consultant at Robert Walters, you'll combine your commercial drive with your passion for people. You'll connect organizations with experienced professionals, develop your own network and play a key role in helping businesses find the expertise they need.

We are looking to strengthen our Interim Management team in Brussels. If you're ambitious, entrepreneurial and ready to take ownership of your career, we'd love to meet you.

Your role

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll be part of our Interim Management team, working at the intersection of people, business and opportunity.

You'll manage the recruitment process from start to finish, while building long-term relationships with organizations and professionals. No two days are the same: one moment you could develop a new business opportunity, the next you're speaking with an experienced professional about their next career move.

You'll have the opportunity to:

• Build and grow your own network of organizations and professionals within the Interim Management market
• Identify new business opportunities by understanding what organizations need and where you can add value
• Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with business partners
• Search for, assess and connect experienced professionals with the right interim management opportunities
• Manage the recruitment process from first contact through to successful placement
• Arrange interviews and ensure clear, proactive communication throughout the process
• Meet with prospective business partners and deepen existing relationships
• Proactively develop your portfolio through networking, market outreach and business development
• Work closely with your colleagues, sharing market knowledge, ideas and expertise
• Contribute to the success of the wider team while building your own track record
You'll have real ownership, clear targets and plenty of opportunities to make an impact.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, ambitious and genuinely interested in people.

You'll bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree combined with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience within operations / finance 
• Excellent Dutch and very good English communication skills
• A strong commercial mindset and a genuine drive to achieve results
• An entrepreneurial attitude and the confidence to create and pursue new opportunities
• Strong negotiation skills and a strategic approach
• A natural interest in business, people and the world of work
• A strong team spirit and a collaborative mindset
You're someone who takes initiative, enjoys a challenge and isn't afraid to pick up the phone or open a new door. You know how to build trust, you're comfortable working towards targets and you're motivated by seeing the impact of your work. Above all, you're looking for more than just a job: you want to build a career where your ambition can grow with you.

• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.
